findings.message: This is an instance fix of the previous B2 finding. The one new row (fleet:refused + --retry + missing claude credential) is checked through `gate`, which asserts only rc and message. It still never asserts that `$CALLS` holds no `azdo-issue untag`, `create`, `fields`, `tag`, `claim` or `pipelines run`. The requested `--create` row, where the work item is missing and a later gate fails, was not added. The ac18 detector widening still exercises nothing, because its `row()` does not pass `--retry` or `--create`. Assert that `$CALLS` has no write command in these rows and add the `--create` + missing-credential row.
findings.scenario: Revert the write-before-gate reorder so `trigger --retry` untags `fleet:refused` first and then fails on the missing claude-token. The row still returns rc 4 with 'no registered claude credential', so the test stays green while the refused tag has been removed.

findings.message: The junk-Job-JSON test only asserts the dispatch path. The `trigger` call on each row discards its result with `|| true`, so the check-only path (`check_only_busy`, T_BUSY_CHECK) is never verified against empty, unparsable, non-object or uid-less JSON. AC8 covers only GET_ERR, not junk output. Assert that `codex_busy_check` starts with `not-run` for every junk row.
findings.scenario: Change `check_only_busy`'s default branch to `*) ;;`, or make it treat an empty state as clear. `trigger` with JOB_RAW='' then reports the busy check as clear, but the test stays green because the trigger output is never inspected.

findings.message: This commit changes plugin code under plugins/specclaw-fleet and bumps no version. The earlier finding asked for a bump and this round did not make one. Bump every plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, every plugins/*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json and every plugins[] entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to one new identical version.
findings.scenario: Plugin code changed with no version change, so the installed plugin version stays at 0.8.9 and users on 0.8.9 never receive the codex slot fix.
